cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line1: A thousand years ago, a rain of stars fell upon this world.

cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line3: To guard them, the ancients forged a warden: Valerius.
cinematic.aetheria.adventure.line4: But the guardian has fallen. Now his runes devour the sky.

quest.aetheria.awakening.title: Awakening of the Runes
quest.aetheria.awakening.desc: Find a Celestial Stele Fragment in the Sunken Ruins, hidden below the surface.
quest.aetheria.awakening.hint: The ruins lie between Y -20 and Y 20: explore caves. Look for mossy stone bricks, an amethyst stele in the middle and a chest in a corner. Fallback: /locate structure aetheria:sunken_ruins
quest.aetheria.awakening.reward: +20 max mana, 1 Astral point, title "Awakened", 50 XP.
quest.aetheria.staff.title: The Archmage Staff
quest.aetheria.staff.desc: Craft your first magic focus: the Celestial Archmage Staff.
quest.aetheria.staff.hint: Astral Shard: amethyst + glowstone dust + lapis (x2). Astral Ingot: gold ingot + 3 shards. Staff: 2 astral ingots, 1 Stele Fragment and 2 blaze rods in a diagonal.
quest.aetheria.staff.reward: 80 XP. Astral Bolt is already unlocked: right-click or R to cast it.
quest.aetheria.invoker.title: Path of the Invoker
quest.aetheria.invoker.desc: Unlock new spells and cast 3 different spells.
quest.aetheria.invoker.hint: Grimoire: book + astral shard + amethyst shard. Open the rune tree with G and spend your Astral points. V switches spell, R casts it.
quest.aetheria.sigil.title: The Astral Sigil
quest.aetheria.sigil.desc: Locate the Dark Observatory and craft the Astral Sigil that awakens its guardian.
quest.aetheria.sigil.hint: Right-click a Stele Fragment: it shows the distance and coordinates of the nearest Observatory (in the End, or floating above large mountains). Sigil: 2 eyes of ender, 2 astral ingots, 1 Stele Fragment.
quest.aetheria.guardian_trial.title: Trial of the Guardian
quest.aetheria.guardian_trial.desc: Use the Sigil on the Astral Altar at the heart of the Observatory and defeat Valerius.
quest.aetheria.guardian_trial.hint: Jump to dodge his ground slam wave. When the orbs appear, destroy them or hide behind a crystal pillar before the Absolute Judgement. At 15% health he enrages: stay inside the arena circle.
quest.aetheria.guardian_trial.reward: +50 max mana, 3 Astral points, title "Guardian of Runes", Engraved Rune Heart, Eclipse Rampart.
quest.aetheria.awakened.title: Awakening of Arms
quest.aetheria.awakened.desc: Forge an Awakened weapon with the Engraved Rune Heart.
quest.aetheria.awakened.hint: Awakened Staff: Archmage Staff + Rune Heart + 5 astral ingots. Awakened Blade: Eclipse Blade + Rune Heart + 5 astral ingots.
quest.aetheria.awakened.reward: +50 max mana, 2 Astral points, title "Ascendant", 300 XP.
